_comment: TEMPLATE (claude-md/templates/features.json) - feature list for multi-session work on one spec.
Copy to specs/<slug>.features.json next to specs/<slug>.md: one entry per AC, or per slice of an AC.
Agents edit only passes and evidence. Set passes to true only with evidence: file:line, a test name, or a command and its exit code.
Entries are never removed. description and verify change only with the owner's OK.
The spec-integrity guard step enforces this against the base refs (owner OK = ALLOW_GUARD_CHANGE=1).
Public-safe: no secrets, hosts, IPs or client names. This _comment key can be deleted.
